{{Top|leg}}
'''Velmoc flu''' was an ailment native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. It apparently had some ties to the native [[Velmoc]] from that planet. After the disease had been beaten, the individual would then have a natural immunity to catching the Velmoc flu a second time. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denid]] contracted the disease during his exile on [[Tantajoc V]], but he survived. Following his return to Velmor, the royal physician, [[Chozz Wardle]] noted that Denid had beaten the disease in his report, which helped confirm that Denid was, in fact, the real crown prince.
